title: Cherry-pick a Conflicting Commit
objective: Bring one audit commit onto main and resolve the conflict without merging the whole branch.
description: Main requires audit logging while feature/audit makes it verbose. Cherry-pick the feature commit onto main, resolve policy.txt to audit=required+verbose, and continue the paused cherry-pick.

lesson.principle: Cherry-pick replays one chosen commit. Its result has one parent, unlike a merge commit with two parents.
lesson.question: After resolving and staging policy.txt during a paused cherry-pick, which command resumes it?
lesson.explanation: git cherry-pick --continue finishes the replay of the selected feature commit on main.
pitfalls: Merging the entire feature branch instead of replaying one commit.
Running git commit while CHERRY_PICK_HEAD is present.
Keeping verbose audit but dropping the required audit rule.

hints: Stay on main and run git cherry-pick feature/audit. Git pauses at policy.txt.
Set policy.txt to audit=required+verbose and run git add policy.txt.
Run git cherry-pick --continue, then check the final linear history with git log --oneline --graph.
